analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.20) vs SMA5 ($0.18)/SMA20 ($0.19)/SMA50 ($0.18) — Confirmed above short- and mid-term trends.
· Above SMA100 ($0.19), below SMA200 ($0.22) — Indicating a mid- to long-term trend reversal phase.
· 52-week position (7.3%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.3→62.8) — Exited oversold, entered neutral zone, confirming upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0010→-0.0004) — Continued improvement in negative territory, signaling weakening bearishness.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near middle band $0.19) — Bandwidth (19.67%) at moderate levels.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.16) — Based on Pivot S1 ($0.17) and 5-day low ($0.17).
· Swing resistance ($0.20) — Aligns with current price; potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) — Confirmed recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (3.30x) — Increased confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — Consider buying on a breakout above the $0.20 resistance.
